info.title: SpillSense API
info.description: Spill incident data management & analytics: filterable incident queries, GeoJSON for mapping, statistical rollups, and import-run auditing.

get.summary: All 39 Washington counties with Ecology region assignments

get.description: Streams the filtered incident set as a CSV attachment. Accepts the same filters as the incident list.

parameters.name: County
parameters.description: Washington county name, without the "County" suffix (e.g. Thurston).

parameters.name: Region
parameters.description: Department of Ecology regional office.

parameters.name: Medium
parameters.description: Environmental medium primarily affected.

parameters.name: Category
parameters.description: Substance reporting category.

parameters.name: Source
parameters.description: Kind of source the spill originated from.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: Lifecycle state of the incident record.

parameters.name: From
parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound on the report date (date or ISO 8601 date-time, UTC).

parameters.name: To
parameters.description: Exclusive upper bound on the report date.

parameters.name: Search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive text match across substance, description, responsible party, location, waterbody, and report number.

parameters.name: Bbox
parameters.description: Spatial filter as minLon,minLat,maxLon,maxLat in WGS 84.

parameters.name: MinGallons
parameters.description: Only incidents with an estimated quantity at or above this value.

parameters.name: HasCoordinates
parameters.description: Restrict to incidents that do (true) or do not (false) carry map coordinates.

parameters.name: Page
parameters.description: 1-based page number. Defaults to 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: Records per page, between 1 and 200. Defaults to 25.

parameters.name: Sort
parameters.description: Sort order; prefix with '-' for descending. Defaults to -reportedAt.

get.description: Composed rollup for one calendar year: totals, quarterly breakdown, top counties and substances by volume, largest incidents, and year-over-year change. Shaped for report tooling (SSRS-style) and briefings.

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: Calendar year to report on, between 1990 and 2100.

post.description: Runs the intake pipeline on an uploaded CSV: rows are validated, upserts are idempotent by report number, and rejected rows are quarantined. Returns the completed import run with its counts.
